thread:
sam (sales): FYI vendor 'NimbusAI' POC kicked off but they sent a partially filled CAIQ and a generic SOC2 link. CISO asked for a short risk summary for the deal so we can move to pricing. can secops triage? link: https://redwood.company/sales/nimbusai-poc :wave:

jessica (secops): On it. I skimmed the CAIQ — gaps on key management, MFA for admin console, and unclear logging retention. I'll do a quick triage and call out blockers for enterprise purchase.

arun (eng): Heads up — POC requires streaming inference and a private peering option. Do they support VPC peering or private link? If not, we need to flag network isolation.

vendor-rep: Hi team — thanks. We can support AWS PrivateLink and AAD SSO. Key management: customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (CMKs) is in roadmap; currently we offer tenant keys with HSM. SOC2 Type II report is available and attached here: https://nimbus.ai/reports/soc2-2025.pdf

jessica (secops): Thanks. Can you confirm: encryption at rest with customer keys today? Your CAIQ answer says 'encryption at rest: yes' but doesn't specify customer-managed vs vendor-managed. We need explicit answer for enterprise.

vendor-rep: Confirmed: today encryption at rest uses our HSM-managed keys; customer-managed KMS planned Q3. We can do contractual wording re: bring-your-own-key in enterprise contract.

mike (legal): If BYOK is roadmap-only, legal will need timeline + rollback plan. Also need subprocessors list and DPA template. Please upload to the shared drive.

jessica (secops): Triage summary for sales/CISO: major: no customer-managed keys yet (controls gap for high-risk data). medium: unclear admin MFA and logging retention. low: SOC2 present but need pen test evidence and scope. Recommendation: proceed with POC under a limited data classification (no sensitive PII), request BYOK commitment and subcontractor list before prod.

sam (sales): Helpful. We need a one-paragraph risk note for the exec sponsor and the pricing team. Can someone draft a 2–3 sentence blurb we can paste into the deal?

arun (eng): Draft: "NimbusAI passed initial security screening (SOC2 Type II). Current production uses vendor-managed encryption keys and HSM; customer-managed KMS support is planned — BYOK commitment required before productionizing sensitive data. Network isolation via PrivateLink is supported; please limit POC traffic to non-sensitive datasets."

jessica (secops): I'll shorten and add action items: "Security note: NimbusAI provides SOC2 Type II and HSM-managed encryption today but does not yet support customer-managed keys. For enterprise production, customer-managed KMS (BYOK) is required; vendor provided timeline must be contractually committed. Pending admin MFA proof and pen-test scope. POC may proceed with non-sensitive data only. Action: vendor to provide BYOK timeline, subprocessors list, and proof of MFA + pen test." :memo: 

vendor-scan-bot: Automated vuln scan completed: 2 medium findings (outdated dependency in websocket lib), 0 critical. Full report: https://nimbus.ai/reports/scan-177980.json

vendor-rep: We'll triage the dependency and share remediation ETA by EOD. Also uploading subprocessors and DPA draft now.

mike (legal): Received DPA draft. Will review and flag any risky clauses. If BYOK commitment is provided as MSA exhibit, ops can sign off quicker.

sam (sales): Great — please keep me posted. If secops says low enough risk with the BYOK pledge + DPA, we can push a 'limited-prod' price tier. Thanks team :thumbsup:
